chapters.title: Larp Club
chapters.description: Pretend you work in tech. Then someone asks a follow-up.

chapters.title: Start with a role.
chapters.description: A tech roleplay game built at LarpHacks. No sign-up needed.

chapters.title: The photo is the easy part.
chapters.description: The joke gets you in. The follow-up question gets you learning.

chapters.title: Pick your situation.
chapters.description: Play the founder, the incident responder, or the AI visionary.

chapters.title: You are the founder now.
chapters.description: SnackOverflow has a pitch deck. You still have to decide what to ship.

chapters.title: Commit to a terrible plan.
chapters.description: Wrong replies get a comic consequence and a useful explanation.

chapters.title: Then make a better decision.
chapters.description: Choose one usable flow. Learn what an MVP actually means.

chapters.title: This error came from a real server.
chapters.description: POST returns 405: that method is not supported for reading the menu.

chapters.title: Fix the request. Get real JSON.
chapters.description: GET /demo-snacks returns 200 and sample inventory from our backend.

chapters.title: A completed role comes with a debrief.
chapters.description: See the skills practised during the story. Titles are just for fun.

chapters.title: Now try data you have not seen before.
chapters.description: The Hot Seat fetches fresh inventory. Type your answers without choices.

chapters.title: Back up the confidence.
chapters.description: Read the success code, add stock units, and count sold-out snacks.

chapters.title: Bring the group chat.
chapters.description: Create a room and share its QR invite. Everyone gets the same inventory.

chapters.title: Let the server settle it.
chapters.description: Three attempts. Scores of 100, 75, or 50. Refresh to see new submissions.

chapters.title: Take the skills with you.
chapters.description: Request a one-time Agentboxd receipt after finishing a role. No mailing list.
